Field.Label: Auth Token (optional):
Field.Description: If set, requests must include header "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" (or X-Auth-Token / ?token=)

Field.Label:
The plugin runs an HTTP server that receives health data.
Configure a Health Auto Export REST API automation to POST JSON to: http://YOUR_INDIGO_SERVER_IP:8888/health
Add custom header: X-User-ID with your user identifier (e.g., Mike) Or use URL parameter: ?userId=Mike
Recommended: Export Version 2, Summarize Data ON, Date Range "Default".
